interest.title: Are you living with constant tension, poor posture, or joint stiffness?
interest.subheadline: Over 20 years of expertise and an exclusive Japanese method — in Marbella & Puerto Banús.
interest.body: Modern life takes a toll on our bodies. Whether it's from sitting at a desk, playing golf, or simply the stress of daily life, muscular imbalances can lead to persistent discomfort. At Prisma Clinic, we offer an exclusive Therapeutical Massage based on the principles of Yumeiho — a renowned Japanese method designed to address the root cause of physical tension rather than just treating the symptoms.

method.title: Discover Yumeiho: The Art of Japanese Therapeutical Massage
method.subheadline: Developed by Saionji Masayuki, Yumeiho beautifully combines the wisdom of 4,000 years of Far Eastern practices with modern anatomical knowledge.
method.body: This signature therapeutical massage integrates a dynamic 100-pressure therapy system with Shiatsu techniques for deep muscle relief, connective tissue massage to release tight fascia, lymphatic drainage to promote detoxification, and reflexology with targeted stretching to restore mobility. The primary aim is to promote complete muscular relaxation by supporting the natural alignment of the pelvis, spine and joints. By gently addressing postural imbalances, this treatment releases deep-seated physical blockages — many of which may have been present for years — leaving you with a profound feeling of lightness, mobility and deep relaxation.
method.videoAlt: Yumeiho therapeutical massage demonstration at Prisma Clinic

benefits.title: Benefits of Our Therapeutical Massage
benefits.body: Our Yumeiho-based therapeutical massage is highly sought after by patients in Marbella and Puerto Banús looking for effective, non-invasive relief and preventative healthcare. This therapy is highly effective in helping to manage and alleviate:

items.title: Postural Imbalances
items.description: Supports the management of scoliosis-related tension and general poor posture.

items.title: Asymmetries
items.description: Helps address feelings of unevenness, such as perceived leg length differences and foot angle misalignment.

items.title: Back & Neck Tension
items.description: Releases stiffness in the lower back, shoulders, and neck.

items.title: Joint Discomfort
items.description: Improves natural mobility in the hips, knees, and shoulders.

items.title: Sciatic & Nerve Tension
items.description: Relieves the muscular pressure that often exacerbates sciatic discomfort.

items.title: Muscle Fatigue & Stress
items.description: Dissolves physical blockages, promoting a sense of whole-body wellness and energy flow.

leadExpert.title: Behrouz Rajabi
leadExpert.body: At Prisma Clinic, you are in the hands of a true expert. Behrouz Rajabi is a specialist with over 20 years of international experience and the official representative of the Japanese Yumeiho method for Germany since 2009. Founder of the Institute for Japanese Osteopathy in Germany (2015) and owner of the patent for Japanese osteopathy, he began his Yumeiho training in 2004. Originally trained as a Mechanical Engineer (Diplom, Hamburg 1995), Behrouz brings an engineer's deep understanding of structure, balance, and alignment to the human body, later expanding his medical knowledge at the Amara Alternative Medicine School (2010–2012). Through his extensive practice across Tehran and Hamburg, and his ongoing work hosting professional seminars, he brings a world-class level of therapeutic touch to Marbella.

Whether you need a single implant, aesthetic smile enhancement, or expert endodontic treatment, our team creates a clear, comfortable plan that fits your goals and schedule. We focus on minimally invasive techniques, fast recovery, and long-lasting results so you can enjoy your smile and local life again.

items.title: Veneers

items.title: Teeth Whitening
items.description: Professional whitening treatments for a brighter, fresher smile with safe, predictable results.

items.title: Crowns & Bridges
items.description: Durable, natural-looking restorations for damaged or missing teeth, built to last.

items.title: Preventive Checkups

leadExpert.title: Dr. Robbin M.
leadExpert.body: Dr. Robbin M. is a dental specialist with over 10 years' experience in endodontics, dental implants and aesthetic dental solutions. A King's College London graduate, he combines specialist training with a gentle, patient-first approach. Dr. Robbin is known for predictable implant outcomes, pain-minimising root canal procedures and natural-looking cosmetic results — always tailored to each patient's facial balance and lifestyle.
